title: Scalar completion augmentation on a pulled coherent quotient tower
statement: Fix l,E,L,iota,W,f, an E completed-operation model ME and an L Roos model rho [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Let P be good and eP:Q(P) iso K, with a coherent quotient presentation C and strict scalar/pullback comparison q satisfying its tensor-unit formula [stage3-pur-scalar-pullback-roos-coordinates]. Let R be any good representative of E-pullback(K), eR its comparison, and (D,eD,kappaD) any coherent quotient presentation. Let epsilonD be the invertible scalar cochain counit and qD a scalar quotient tower comparison with its scalar tensor-generator formula. Form rD by scalar(eD), epsilonD, the Roos bridge and qD. Then the localized scalar completion chain on R, followed by rD inverse, scalar(reduction(eR) followed by pullbackReduction), and the fixed scalar/pullback coordinate, is the ordinary scalar image of eR and eP inverse followed by the ordinary pulled representative comparison and scalarPullbackChain. This is an equality of augmentation/quotient maps with no scalar realization model, completeness hypothesis or scalar completion inverse.

source.place: Tags 06YY (derived tensor), 07A4 (pullback and tensor), 0941 (derived limits); the normalization part of step 8 of lem-pur-scalar-extension-tower-coherence.

proof.text: Use coherentReferenceQuotientComparison to transport C and D to the ordinary strict quotient models, retaining their entire-system adjunction equations. Transpose reduction(eR) followed by pullbackReduction under the reduction/limit adjunction; its counit cancels reduction of the E-pullback realization. Pullback normalization identifies the result with the ordinary strict pullback tensor-unit map. Use ordinaryQuotientPullbackTowerComparison and ordinaryQuotientScalarTowerComparison for the two strict coordinate associations.

Associate the scalar tensors at every finite level and apply the inverse-image unit. The scalar/pullback association sends 1 tensor gamma(x) to gamma(1 tensor x). The hqD and hq formulas give equality on nested unit generators. The inverse-image and tensor adjunctions, with local surjectivity of completed-to-finite coefficients, give equality of strict tower maps, retaining all quotient transitions and differentials.

Apply Roos to the equality of strict maps and insert the scalar completion augmentation. Its unshifted coordinate is the compatible quotient projection; its shifted coordinate is zero. The scalar/Roos product map followed by scalarPullbackTower is scalarPullbackChain. K-injective-normalized bridge naturality transports this cochain equality to the total derived limit. Conjugating by eD, epsilonD and qD gives exactly rD inverse and the displayed equality. Zero complexes, empty sites, identity maps, n=0 and ramified embeddings use these same balanced tensors.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YY, 07A4 and 0941; augmentation and quotient-identification part of the right-route normalization calculation.

    (κD : ∀ n : ℕ,

    (hpD : CoefficientReductionPresentation.{u, u} l E (W true)

    (hcD : IsIntegralComparisonPresentationCoherent.{u, u} l E (W true)
      (ME.calculus true) R.obj D eD κD)

    (hεD : εD.hom = (integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι (W true)).ε.app D)
    (qD : (((coefficientSequenceRestriction.{u, u} l L (W true)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj
      (((integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι (W true)).E.mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj D)).asFunctor ≅
      (integralScalarTowerFunctor.{u, u} l E L ι (W true)).obj R.obj)
    (hqD : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : (W true).ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (s : (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l L (W true)).obj.obj (op (n, U.unop)))
        (x : (R.obj.X i).val.obj U),
        ((qD.hom.app (op n)).f i).val.app U
          (integralComparisonRestrictedSection l L (W true)
            ((integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel l E L ι (W true)).E.obj (D.X i)) n U
            (integralComparisonSequenceTensorSection l E L ι (W true) (D.X i)
              (op (n, U.unop)) s
              (integralComparisonSequenceSection l E (W true) (D.X i) n U
                (((κD n).inv.f i).val.app U
                  (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E (W true) n (R.obj.X i) U 1 x))))) =
          integralScalarTensorSection l E L ι (W true) n (R.obj.X i) U s x) :
    let T := coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L (W true)
    let A := integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι (W true)
    let SD :=
      ((integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι (W true)).E.mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj D
    let rD := T.mapIso (A.mapIso eD ≪≫ εD) ≪≫
      integralComparisonRoosBridge.{u, u} l L (W true) ρ SD ≪≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso (integralOperationsRoosFunctor.mapIso qD)
    (integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι (W true)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app R.obj ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((integralScalarCompletionChain l E L ι (W true)).app R.obj) ≫
      rD.inv ≫
      T.map (A.map ((ME.calculus true).reduction.map eR.hom ≫
        pullbackReduction l E W ME f K)) ≫
      scalarPullbackRoosCoordinate l E L ι f P C (ME.calculus false) ρ K eP eC q =
    (integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι (W true)).map eR.hom ≫
      (integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι (W true)).map
        ((integralDerivedPullback.{u, u} l E f).map eP.inv) ≫
      (integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι (W true)).map
        ((integralDerivedPullbackComparison.{u, u} l E f).hom.app P) ≫
      (integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι (W true)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        ((integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor.{u, u} l E f).obj P.obj) ≫
